proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ μ _ X Y hX hY
  have h : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ ProbabilityTheory.variance Y μ * (t * t) + (2 * ProbabilityTheory.covariance X Y μ) * t + ProbabilityTheory.variance X μ := by
    intro t
    have h0 := ProbabilityTheory.variance_nonneg (fun ω => t * Y ω + X ω) μ
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.variance_fun_add (hY.const_mul t) hX,
      ProbabilityTheory.variance_const_mul, ProbabilityTheory.covariance_const_mul_left,
      ProbabilityTheory.covariance_comm Y X] at h0
    nlinarith [h0]
  have hd := discrim_le_zero h
  unfold discrim at hd
  nlinarith [hd]
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X Y : Ω → ℝ), MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 μ → MeasureTheory.MemLp Y 2 μ → ProbabilityTheory.covariance X Y μ ^ 2 ≤ ProbabilityTheory.variance X μ * ProbabilityTheory.variance Y μ
